content_metadata.description: This video presents an interview with Thomas Hildmann discussing the use of Nextcloud at the Technische Universität Berlin.

qAndA.answer: Storing and sharing files, including paperwork, raw data, and research materials.
qAndA.question: What is Nextcloud primarily used for at the Technische Universität Berlin?

qAndA.answer: It integrates well with the existing infrastructure, provides a good user experience, and allows for data control and security by storing data in their own data center.
qAndA.question: Why does Thomas Hildmann believe Nextcloud is a good solution for the university?
How many files are currently stored in the university's Nextcloud instance?

qAndA.answer: The Deck Kanban board, which helps with project management and task tracking within small groups.
qAndA.question: What is Thomas Hildmann's favorite feature of Nextcloud?

qAndA.answer: Implementing a high-availability solution for files within the next month to enhance scalability and data resilience.
qAndA.question: What new idea is Thomas Hildmann taking away from the Nextcloud Enterprise Day?

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I'm Thomas Irman from the Technical University of Berlin and I'm working at the Data Center
there and providing next cloud for the whole staff and the students there.
Great and what do you use next cloud for?
We are using next cloud for nearly everything that you can imagine at the university.
We are storing our paper there, our role data and also things that is worked on the whole day.
And why is next cloud the best solution for you?
It is very well integrated in the infrastructure at the university.
Everyone who starts at the university gets an account and can start storing and sharing files and getting things shared from others.
So how many people are using next cloud?
On a daily basis about 2 or 3,000 but we are about 20,000 or 30,000 users over the time.
What are they saying about next cloud? Do they like it? Have any feedback?
It is a very important tool for them for the everyday work.
We are using next cloud for more than 10 years and there were some periods where some things don't work as expected.
But over the whole time, it is something that is used every day and we see that it is a very important tool for them.
And what ways would you improve next cloud or what would you like to see?
For us, scalability is a very important thing. We have a growing number of files in our next cloud instance.
Stances and at the moment we are on about 400 million files there and still growing.
And that is something we have to handle. For us, the most important thing we have to look in the future.
What makes next cloud stand out among other solutions or competitors?
First of all, it is a user experience. It is impossible to make people store their files in a solution that is not easy to use.
So from the beginning, we looked at one of the main points. It is still one of the things that I think is outstanding.
Another point is that we store all data in our own data center. We have full control of all the data and the data is a treasure of the university.
That is the point. Having control of it is the most important thing.
That is great to hear. What has changed in your organization since using next cloud?
It was long time ago when we started this next cloud. I cannot really remember how it was before.
When I think back, I had this heartless, I carried from home to office and back.
We had all these CDs and so on. We exchanged all, and every word file was exchanged by email and so on.
That is completely changed. Everything is in our next cloud and everything can be shared to groups or other people and added it together.
That is the way that we work on files since years.
What is your favorite feature of next cloud?
I like the deck Kanban board very much because in small groups, it is a great tool to track the task.
You have to make notes on it why what has to be done next or what already happened there and so on.
It is a good visualization of the task that is coming up next or what you do now and I have already done.
I think that is really good and it is really good combined with the files.
You do not have to copy and paste things from the requirements or something like that.
You just link the file with the requirements at the task and you are done. That is something I really like.
That is nice to hear and I also agree that deck is really a great tool and in the next cloud, between all employees, we use it as well.
So yeah, today is next cloud enterprise day. How do you like the event?
I learned a lot again and I saw some people I have been in contact for a long time and that was also really great.
I talked with others, administrators and decision makers and so on.
I think I am going home with some new ideas.
What are your biggest takeaways?
One of the biggest things is that we will start with a high availability solution for files next month.
Let us see how this deals with our database requests and how we can make a next step to the scalability thing I mentioned at the beginning.
Great, we hope to see you at the next enterprise day and thank you.
